sample_unit: LLM responses (27 scenarios x 3 models x 2 languages)

links.outcome: LLM response quality in dental trauma scenarios, English vs Turkish, by model
links.effect: ChatGPT 9.14% higher in English (p<0.001, r=0.874); Gemini 5.69% higher in English (p=0.003); Claude no difference (-0.02%, p=0.220).
links.quote: Claude exhibited language independence with virtually identical performance in both languages (-0.02%, p = 0.220).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of three LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) answering simulated dental trauma clinical scenarios in English versus Turkish, assessing accuracy, completeness, and safety without testing a specific organizational deployment practice.
